payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CLEAR approach demonstrates better generalizability when transferred from the Room-Across-Room (RxR) dataset to the Room-to-Room (R2R) dataset, suggesting that zero-shot transfer is feasible.

claims.text: The CLEAR approach shows better generalizability when transferred to the Room-to-Room (R2R) dataset from the Room-Across-Room (RxR) dataset.
Empirical results indicate that the CLEAR method can effectively transfer learned representations from RxR to R2R, achieving improved performance.
